instruction: Retrieve the layered material MoS2 from Materials Project using mp_api. Use Pymatgen to build a bilayer MoS2 structure by stacking two monolayers along the c-axis and export it as a CIF file. Then open the CIF file in Materials Studio, select all atoms, build a surface using default parameters, and save the file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\MoS2.xsd'.
